  html:
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(testthat)
library(kableExtra)


release <- read_table("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols/HBCD.fam", col_names=c("FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO")) |>
  mutate(
    IID2 = str_sub(IID, -10, -1),
    FID2 = str_sub(IID, -10, -2)
  )

# identifiers <- read_csv("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_br_20p0/concat/genetics/genotype_microarray/smokescreen/release_identifiers_20251006_ccEdit.csv")
identifiers <- read_csv("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/release_identifiers_20251006.csv") |>
    mutate(release_candid = as.numeric(release_candid))

parVisit <- read_table("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/par_visit_data.tsv") |>
  # filter(session_id == "V01") |>
  distinct(participant_id)

info <- read_table("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols/batch.info")

convTable <- release %>%
  left_join(identifiers, by = c("FID2" = "pscid")) |>
  mutate(
    pscidR = paste0(FID2, str_sub(IID, -1, -1)),
    candid = as.numeric(candid)
  ) |>
  filter(candid %in% parVisit$participant_id)

info <- info |> inner_join(convTable, by = c("IID" = "pscidR"))

info |>
  select(IID, plate_number, visit) |>
  write_delim("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols_exclude_par_visit_data/data/batch.info", delim = "\t")


info |>
  select(`#FID` = FID, IID= IID.y) |>
  write_delim("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols_exclude_par_visit_data/keepIDs.txt", delim = "\t")
```

```{bash}
plink2 --bfile /projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols/HBCD \
  --out /projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols_exclude_par_visit_data/data/HBCD \
  --make-bed \
  --keep /projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/HBCD_genomics_release_excludecontrols_exclude_par_visit_data/keepIDs.txt

```
